description: Exact-source CI compatibility drill between a pinned historical candidate baseline and current so. The baseline is explicitly not a release artifact. Current expanded PostgreSQL migrations and the registered HTTP route authority are verified first; the baseline SQL and reviewed Go integration surfaces must pass sequentially without changing the current memory_os schema fingerprint, then current tests must pass independently. Rejected candidate SHAs remain in an immutable machine-readable rejection registry rather than being silently replaced. This is a pre-release compatibility foundation, not rolling deployment, downgrade or production mixed-version evidence.

candidateBaseline.selectionReason: Exact historical backend already proven to build and run concurrently with current code in the pinned old/current session drill; no release approval is claimed.

requiredSteps: verify candidate baseline is an ancestor of current exact source SHA and is absent from the rejected candidate registry
verify the current registered HTTP upload routes, pre-auth route-shape filter, metrics labels and rate-limit policy share one machine-readable authority
create a detached read-only worktree at the pinned candidate baseline
create separate baseline-compatibility and current-verification PostgreSQL databases
apply the current canonical migration sequence to both databases
capture the production memory_os schema fingerprint before baseline execution
execute candidate SQL integration tests in the exact order recorded by the baseline migration registry or its own Security Contracts workflow
execute reviewed Go package surfaces sequentially when they exist in both exact source trees, preventing shared-database cross-package interference
capture the production memory_os schema fingerprint after baseline execution and require equality
execute current canonical SQL and common Go integration tests sequentially against the separate current database
write exact baseline/current SHAs and bounded counts without credentials or database URLs
successCriteria: candidate baseline is an ancestor of current source and is not rejected
the current direct upload completion route reaches its registered handler while unknown high-cardinality routes remain pre-auth 404
both databases receive all current canonical migrations
all candidate baseline canonical SQL tests pass on current expanded schema
candidate baseline selected Go packages compile and pass sequentially
baseline execution does not change the normalized current memory_os schema fingerprint
all current canonical SQL tests pass
current selected Go packages compile and pass sequentially
no secret, database URL, object key, token or user content enters evidence
result remains classified as candidate compatibility rather than release or production evidence
abortCriteria: baseline SHA is missing, rejected, not an ancestor or differs from the contract
current registered route, route-shape filter, metrics or rate-limit authority diverges
source or target database identity is ambiguous
current migration sequence cannot apply cleanly
baseline has neither a migration registry nor an ordered Security Contracts workflow
any baseline SQL or sequential common Go test fails
normalized memory_os schema fingerprint changes after baseline execution
any current SQL or sequential common Go test fails
evidence would include credentials, connection URLs or user content
limitations: candidate baseline is not an approved release
separate databases rather than simultaneous old/current traffic
local MinIO rather than production object storage
no rolling deployment order or connection-drain failure injection
no downgrade or destructive contract migration
